one_line: Emperor Harsha overseeing Nalanda’s village stewards who sustain the great monastic university through agrarian revenues.

appearance.age_look: Harsha appears mid-30s, lean but regal; the chief steward appears late-40s, sturdy, and work-worn.
appearance.face: Harsha has an oval face, medium-brown North Indian complexion, sharp nose, calm wide eyes, and a composed, slightly kind expression; the steward has a squarer jaw, deeper sun-tanned complexion, crow’s-feet, and a thoughtful, serious gaze.
appearance.hair: Harsha’s straight black hair is shoulder-length, neatly oiled, and pulled back with a narrow gold band circlet; the steward’s hair is short, wavy, black with a few grey strands, combed back, with no headwear.
appearance.costume: Harsha wears a knee-length, cream-coloured cotton tunic (angarkha-style, overlapping front, tied at the side) with a thin red border, over a soft saffron dhoti tightly wrapped and pleated at the front, and a long deep-red cotton uttariya draped from his left shoulder across the chest and over the right arm; he has simple gold stud earrings, a single thin gold necklace, and leather sandals; the steward wears a plain off-white dhoti tied at the waist, a light brown cotton waistcloth tied as a short vest leaving a fully covered torso, and a faded dull-green uttariya over both shoulders, plus simple wooden sandals and a cloth belt pouch, all textiles with subtle handwoven texture and no flashy patterns.
appearance.signature: Harsha’s signature prop is a rolled palm-leaf grant bound with a red cord and sealed with a small clay seal stamped with his emblem, held in one hand, while the steward carries a wooden tally staff marked with carved notches and a small cloth ledger tucked at his belt.

ref_desc: Harsha is a medium-brown, oval-faced emperor with shoulder-length black hair and gold circlet, cream tunic, saffron dhoti, deep-red uttariya and palm-leaf grant, beside a squarer-faced steward in off-white dhoti, dull-green uttariya and wooden tally staff, in warm cream and red tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Emperor Harsha and his chief Nalanda steward standing side by side: Harsha is a medium-brown, oval-faced man in his mid-30s with calm, wide eyes, shoulder-length straight black hair held back by a narrow gold band circlet, wearing a knee-length cream cotton tunic with thin red border, a tightly wrapped saffron dhoti with neat front pleats, and a long deep-red cotton uttariya draped from his left shoulder across his chest and over his right arm, finished with simple gold stud earrings, a thin gold necklace, and brown leather sandals; in his right hand he holds a rolled palm-leaf grant bound with a red cord and a small clay seal stamped at one end. Beside him, the steward is a late-40s, sturdier man with a squarer jaw, sun-tanned medium-brown complexion, crow’s-feet, and a serious, thoughtful expression, with short wavy black hair lightly greying at the temples, wearing a plain off-white dhoti, a light brown cotton waistcloth tied as a modest short vest covering the torso, and a faded dull-green uttariya draped over both shoulders, plus simple wooden sandals and a cloth belt pouch; he carries a carved wooden tally staff and has a small cloth ledger tucked at his belt. Use warm, historically grounded colours—cream, saffron, deep red, off-white, dull green and brown—and show their garments and props clearly head-to-toe in a neutral stance suitable for consistent redrawing.
